open_points.subject: INV-001, INV-017 and PLAT-REG-003 witness binding
open_points.text: Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-001, INV-017, PLAT-REG-003 [witness: verification:authorization_guard_client_portal].
open_points.question: Which checks will prove the complete first-failure ordering, uniqueness of active staff assignments, and rejection when Registry returns a UUID different from the requested UUID?
options: Expand verification:authorization_guard_client_portal to assert every omitted case
Bind additional checks that assert the omitted parts
open_points.default_guess: Expand the named check and retain this binding only after it proves all three invariants.

open_points.subject: INV-004 witness binding
open_points.text: Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-004 [witness: verification:staff_identity_uow_client_portal].
open_points.question: Which check will prove that unknown-account and wrong-password failures are indistinguishable in payload and response and never expose project data?
options: Expand verification:staff_identity_uow_client_portal
Bind a separate authentication-concealment check
open_points.default_guess: Expand the named check to compare complete outward results and project-data absence.

open_points.subject: PLAT-REG-006 authorization-guard binding
open_points.text: Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: PLAT-REG-006 [witness: verification:authorization_guard_client_portal]
open_points.question: Which assertion proves that authorization fetches current Registry truth rather than a stored or cached Registry snapshot?
options: Expand verification:authorization_guard_client_portal
Bind a dedicated live-context check
open_points.default_guess: Expand the named check with changing Registry answers and inspection that no current snapshot is stored.

open_points.subject: PLAT-REG-006 derived-view binding
open_points.text: PLAT-REG-006 [witness: verification:derived_views_uow_client_portal].
open_points.question: Which assertion will cover both absence of stored current Registry truth and the archived-readable/no-mutation rule?
options: Expand verification:derived_views_uow_client_portal
Bind separate storage and lifecycle checks
open_points.default_guess: Expand the named check to cover both omitted clauses.

open_points.subject: PLAT-REG-001 Registry linkage binding
open_points.text: no service code generates a project id, the gateway only reads, and every project id the portal stores is one the Registry issued.
open_points.question: How will the check prove, rather than heuristically scan, that no code path can generate a project_id and every stored project_id was Registry-issued, including seeded IDs?
options: Use behavioral instrumentation at every project-id write path
Use an exhaustive structural check plus explicit seed provenance
open_points.default_guess: Instrument all storage paths and require Registry-issued provenance for seeded and newly stored IDs.

open_points.subject: PLAT-REG-005 derived-view binding
open_points.text: Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: PLAT-REG-005 [witness: verification:derived_views_uow_client_portal]
open_points.question: Which check will exercise every RegistryFailureKind and explicitly exclude cached, client-supplied and fabricated fallback context?
options: Expand verification:derived_views_uow_client_portal
Bind a complete gateway failure-table check
open_points.default_guess: Bind a table-driven gateway check covering every kind and every forbidden fallback.

open_points.subject: PLAT-REG-005 API/gateway binding
open_points.text: PLAT-REG-005 [witness: verification:api_transport_financial_policy_registry_gateway_client_portal].
open_points.question: Which assertions will cover the complete closed failure-kind table and all forbidden fallback sources?
options: Expand the named API/gateway check
Bind a separate exhaustive translation check
open_points.default_guess: Expand or replace the binding with an exhaustive table-driven check.

open_points.subject: INV-031 witness binding
open_points.text: an unconfirmed, incomplete, unsupported-version or provider-carrying result is refused at decoding, by `create_expense_from_recognition` and over HTTP, with every table unchanged
open_points.question: Which checks will exercise every named invalid form at all three required boundaries?
options: Expand verification:expense_recognition_projection_client_portal to the full cross-product
Narrow the Required tests claim to the boundaries actually applicable and bind checks for each
open_points.default_guess: Exercise every named form at decoding, operation and HTTP wherever the text claims it must be refused.

options: Add an exact None assertion to verification:budget_derivation_client_portal
Bind a separate missing-progress projection check
open_points.default_guess: Add an exact type-and-value assertion for None in both budget and progress views.

open_points.subject: overall-progress unavailability condition
open_points.text: Overall progress: `Σ(work_planned × percent) / Σ(work_planned)` over sections of the active version with `work_planned > 0` and a recorded progress ... undefined ... when the denominator is 0. ... INV-041: ... overall progress is unavailable ... when no planned work cost exists
open_points.question: Is progress unavailable whenever the filtered denominator is zero, including when planned work exists but none of it has a progress record, or only when the project has no planned work cost at all?
options: Use the filtered denominator: no recorded eligible progress means unavailable
Use total planned work existence: planned work with no progress has another result
open_points.default_guess: Use the filtered denominator stated by the formula.

witness.initial: The active version has one section with work_planned 100.00 and no SectionProgress record.
events: A viewer reads the progress view.
outcomes: The formula excludes the section, obtains denominator zero and returns overall_progress_percent None.
The invariant phrase treats planned work cost as existing and does not require the unavailable result.
witness.observer: The viewer and any caller comparing the returned progress projection.

open_points.subject: DEP-002 public-advisory binding

options: Validate and bind accepted public source identity and metadata
Remove the public-source claim and define trust in the supplied export
open_points.default_guess: Validate the advisory source identity and metadata before accepting the verdict.

open_points.subject: DEP-002 deployment outcome
open_points.text: DEP-002: no deploy ships an image ... with a known vulnerability ... starts the service only on a passing verdict
open_points.question: Does the invariant forbid building or distributing the vulnerable image, or only starting/deploying it as the running service?
options: The image may be built but must never be started as a deployment
The image must not be shipped or distributed at all
open_points.default_guess: Interpret deploy as promotion/start of the exact judged image, and rewrite the invariant to say that explicitly.

witness.initial: The Factory builds and stores an image containing a distribution with a listed vulnerability.
events: The release gate scans the image and returns a failing verdict.
The Factory refuses to start the service but retains or distributes the built artifact.
outcomes: The Required test passes because the service did not start.
DEP-002 fails because an image with a known vulnerability was shipped.
witness.observer: The deployment pipeline and artifact consumers.
